brief.objective: Create a candid vertical lip-tint lifestyle image
brief.promise: A touch-up that belongs to real life

prompt.subject_action: One fictional adult East Asian woman applying lip tint while looking away from camera
prompt.scene: Late-afternoon neighborhood cafe beside a window
prompt.composition: Subject center-right with natural headline space on the left
prompt.camera_light: Rear iPhone 1x camera, mixed window and indoor light, no portrait mode
prompt.materials: Natural skin texture, realistic hair, fabric tension, hands, and lip applicator contact
prompt.negative_constraints: No plastic skin, beauty filter, extreme V-line, extra fingers, fake product text, or influencer grin
